method.covariance: Published evaluated atomic-mass variance/covariance entries in squared nano-u; no dimensionless correlation normalization is applied.
method.diagonal_compatibility: Compare squared nearest-last-place interval around the retained atomic-mass uncertainty to the covariance diagonal; failure holds the affected reductions. method.means: Use precise Part II Table A atomic masses for n,H1,H2,H3,He3,He4 as estimated means, retaining all printed digits. Other required means remain from the electronic table and are not promoted beyond compatible coverage. Baseline mass-excess values are unchanged.
method.precision: Retain all covariance decimal digits. Use a complete selected principal submatrix and exact rational PSD check without correction.
method.primary_documentation_status: Both official Part I and Part II PDFs retained and hashed; precise Table A transcription visually checked. The nearest-last-place gate remains an explicitly declared compatibility criterion.

sigma_convention.systematics_qualification: Part II printed page030003-5, PDFpage6 identifies # values as partly based on trends from the mass surface. Selected adopted atomic masses have no # marker; this adoption does not erase qualifications elsewhere.

method.statistical_scope: AME2020 reports one-standard-deviation uncertainties (Part I printed page030002-2, PDFpage3). Published adjusted covariance and mass estimates are used as moment inputs; no Gaussian distribution, finite support or hard error bound is inferred.

covariance_adoption.reason: Complete published covariance applied only to source-compatible atomic-mass reductions.

source_matrix.rounding: Published decimal coefficients retained exactly; no PSD correction.
